result.summary: Found 3 issues: a critical data display error, a major layout issue with truncated content, and a minor text truncation problem.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows '€NaN delivery' instead of an actual delivery fee amount
issues.suggestion: Fix the data binding or API response handling to ensure delivery fees are properly formatted and displayed as numeric values

issues.description: Restaurant cards in 'Fastest near you' section are horizontally cut off, with the third card (Trattoria Piccol) and subsequent content not fully visible
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel or container has proper overflow handling with visible scroll indicators, or adjust card sizing/spacing to show complete content within the viewport

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' appears truncated - likely should be 'Trattoria Piccolo' or similar
issues.suggestion: Verify the restaurant name in the data source and ensure text has adequate container width or implement proper text truncation with ellipsis if needed
